UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Secure authenticated player profile document in users/{uid}

uid.description: Unique Firebase Authentication UID matching document ID

phoneNumber.description: Verified mobile phone number in E.164 format

role.description: Player security role. Default and strictly locked to 'player'.

status.description: Account operational status. Default and locked to 'active'.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last profile update

/users/{userId}.description: Player profile document. Readable and writable only by the authenticated owner user. Role, status, and UID are immutable.
